PaginationMeta.description: Pagination metadata emitted under `data.meta` (Laravel paginator meta).

current_page.description:
Reusable OpenAPI schemas for paginated API responses.

Two response shapes exist:
- `PaginationMeta` is emitted under `data.meta` by {@see ApiResponse::paginatedWithMeta()}.
- `PaginationFlatMeta` is emitted as flat siblings of `data.items` by {@see ApiResponse::paginated()}.

per_page.description: Items per page. `0` when fetching all items (itemsPerPage=*) with an empty result set.

PaginationFlatMeta.description: Flat pagination fields emitted alongside `data.items` by legacy paginated responses.

itemsPerPage.description: Items per page. `0` when fetching all items (itemsPerPage=*) with an empty result set.

itemsPerPageQueryParam.name: itemsPerPage
itemsPerPageQueryParam.description: Number of items per page (use '*' to get all items, max 100)
